facts.fact: Seychelles News Agency reports the finance ministry set up an online feedback form at finance.gov.sc for itself and its agencies, explained to the press on 19 April 2023, routed to one email address with acknowledgement due in two days.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, National Planning and Trade

facts.fact: The IRM progress report says the e-Engagement portal commitment was not started, with project planning to continue in 2022 and implementation hoped for 2023 pending budget approval.
The Seychelles Revenue Commission introduced a complaints email address and a hotline with WhatsApp for taxpayer feedback on its services, with no case numbers given.
